B & T Capital Management Dba Alpha Capital Management increased its stake in Citigroup Inc (C) by 243.87% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 17,974 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $1.31M, up from 5,227 at the end of the previous reported quarter. B & T Capital Management Dba Alpha Capital Management who had been investing in Citigroup Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $189.36 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.03% or $0.02 during the last trading session, reaching $73.68. About 21.06 million shares traded or 24.11% up from the average. Citigroup Inc. (NYSE:C) has risen 35.60% since March 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.90% the S&P500.
